problem: WRONG TARGET. The spec maps "Your spells... that deal fire damage gain a status bonus to damage equal to half the spell's rank" to targetKind 'spell'. In this app 'spell' is not a generic spellcasting bucket — src/rules/explain.ts defines it as `{ kind: 'spell'; entryId: string; which: 'dc' | 'attack' }`, i.e. the Spell DC and spell-attack-modifier tiles. Burn It grants NO bonus to spell attack rolls or spell DCs; it boosts the damage the spell deals. Starring the Spell DC / spell attack stat with a damage bonus is exactly the mis-target the brief warns about, and a player reading it would think their attack roll or DC went up.
correction: Keep situational:true and needsEngineWork:true but return ZERO bonuses. All three clauses are damage OUTPUT, which has no target kind: (a) spell fire damage (+half the spell's rank, min +1), (b) alchemical-item fire damage (+one-quarter the item's level, min +1), (c) +1 status to persistent fire damage. engineNote should say the missing capability is a spell-/item-damage-output target, not that one clause maps to 'spell'.

problem: INCOMPLETE — a second situational bonus in the same record is dropped. core.json continues past the quoted evidence: "If the religious symbol you're raising is a shield, such as with Emblazon Armaments, you gain the effects of Raise a Shield when you use this action and the effects of this action when you Raise a Shield." That is a conditional AC gain (the shield's circumstance bonus to AC, obtained from an action that otherwise gives none). The same engineer recorded exactly this shape as an 'ac' entry for reactive-shield, so omitting it here is internally inconsistent as well as under-covering the record.
correction: Add a second bonus: { bonus: '+circumstance equal to your shield's AC bonus (normally +2)', when: 'until the start of your next turn, if the religious symbol you Raise is a shield (e.g. via Emblazon Armament) — Raise Symbol and Raise a Shield each trigger the other', targetKind: 'ac' }. Bonus size is dynamic (read from the equipped shield), so keep needsEngineWork/dynamic-size note as on reactive-shield.

problem: INCOMPLETE — a third clause on the same check is dropped: "This attempt has the visual trait, loses the auditory trait, and you don't take a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language." Verified against the Demoralize action (.import-src/pf2e/packs/pf2e/actions/skill/demoralize.json): "If the target doesn't understand the language you are speaking... you take a –4 circumstance penalty to the check." So Deimatic Display removes a –4 circumstance penalty on the very Intimidation check the spec already covers. The same engineer DID record a penalty-removal entry for point-blank-stance (volley trait), so the omission is inconsistent.
correction: Add a third intimidation entry: { bonus: 'ignore Demoralize's –4 circumstance language penalty', when: 'on the Intimidation check to Demoralize made with Deimatic Display, against a creature that does not understand your language', targetKind: 'skill', skill: 'intimidation' } — and, like point-blank-stance, note that the bonus field carries a phrase, not a number.

problem: MISSING needsEngineWork FLAG. The engineNote correctly observes that "The attack-roll form of Aid is not covered by a 'skill' target", but the spec leaves needsEngineWork unset. Verified against the Aid reaction (.import-src/pf2e/packs/pf2e/actions/basic/aid.json): "attempt a skill check or attack roll of a type decided by the GM... or even allow you to Aid checks other than skill checks and attack rolls." So skill:'all' provably cannot cover the whole +4. The identical gap (Escape via unarmed attack modifier) WAS flagged needsEngineWork:true on musetouched, so this is an inconsistent flag, not a judgement difference.
correction: Set needsEngineWork:true, keeping the single skill:'all' bonus. engineNote: the attack-roll form of Aid (and any GM-permitted non-skill Aid check) has no representable target — 'strikeAttack' would wrongly star every attack roll.

problem: OVER-ESCALATED QUESTION. Part (1) of the needsHumanDecision ("what radius should the condition string state?") is not an owner decision — it is answerable from this repo. The corruption in core.json is real ("Creatures within a of the leshy" — confirmed), but the source text at C:\trying ai 2\pf2e codex\.import-src\pf2e\packs\pf2e\feats\class\druid\level-4\leshy-familiar-secrets.json reads "Creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] of the leshy gain a +2 circumstance bonus...". The importer dropped the @Template token, taking the number with it.
correction: State the radius as a 15-foot emanation in the `when` string ("while you are within the 15-foot emanation of your familiar's Purify Air"). Reduce needsHumanDecision to part (2) only — whether the star shows unconditionally with an "if you selected Purify Air today" caveat or only when the daily familiar-ability choice is recorded. Separately worth raising as a core.json data bug: the @Template stripper eats the distance.

problem: The strikeAttack condition is narrowed beyond the record. The trigger reads "An attack you made with a soulforged weapon or shield misses a creature", but the spec's `when` says only "made with your manifested soulforged weapon" — a missed shield bash also triggers the feat and gets the +1.
correction: strikeAttack when → "reaction, on the triggering attack roll you made with your manifested soulforged weapon or shield (Requirements: your soulforged armament is manifested)". The AC entry and the +1 status type are both correct as written.

problem: The classification (situational false) is right, but the stated reason is factually wrong. The record says "You gain the item bonus to attack rolls with your energy blasts from the highest potency rune on any Handwraps of Mighty Blows you are wearing OR ANY WEAPON YOU ARE WIELDING" — that is not "the normal rule" for unarmed attacks (normally only handwraps grant potency to unarmed Strikes; HH's own handwraps buff is guarded on category==='unarmed'). It is a special, non-standard potency source that the engine will not apply on its own.
correction: Keep situational:false and keep needsEngineWork:true, but restate reasonIfNot: "Not a conditional bonus to a character stat — it defines a temporary Strike. Note the potency source is non-standard: the energy blast borrows the highest potency rune from handwraps OR any weapon wielded, so the Strike definition must carry that rule explicitly rather than relying on HH's normal unarmed/handwraps path (striking and property runes do not apply)."

problem: needsHumanDecision is set true for a question that is already answered by the codebase, which would send a resolved item back to the app owner.
correction: Set needsHumanDecision:false. HH's lore key convention is confirmed as `lore:<slug>`, and `lore:engineering` is the exact key already in use (src/rules/featGrantsAuto.ts: 'demolitionist-dedication' → conditionalSkills { 'lore:engineering': ... }, and 'in-the-vault' → skills { 'lore:engineering': 'trained' }). The rest of the entry (item bonus, variable value, Force Open condition) is correct.

problem: The bonus text asserts "the Deception or Intimidation skill you used", but that is not in the record. core.json's description has the skill links stripped: "make your choice of a  or  check against the target's Will DC". The named skills come from outside the record, which breaks the grounding rule (and the same stripped-link defect means the value can't be verified in-app).
correction: Phrase from the record only: bonus → "+2 status (+3 if you're a master, +4 if legendary in the skill you used for the check)", and add a data-defect note that this record's description has empty skill references ("a  or  check") that should be repaired from the source before the wording is finalised. Target (strikeDamage), type (status) and the duel duration are all correct.

problem: Marked situational:false with the claim "grants no bonus of any type to any of your statistics" — that is factually wrong. The record's last sentence reads: "As your first action on your first turn, you can Interact to draw or stow an item of light Bulk as a free action; if this item is a small garment or accessory, such as a fan, a pair of gloves, or a wine glass, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Charisma-based skill checks until the end of your turn." The reviewer only read the initiative/Stunned half of the text. A real, conditional, self-targeting bonus is being dropped.
correction: situational: true, confidence high. Four entries, each bonus '+1 circumstance', when: 'until the end of your turn, if your first action on your first turn is to Interact to draw or stow a small garment or accessory (once per day, after Big Debut)', targetKind 'skill' with skill 'deception', 'diplomacy', 'intimidation' and 'performance' respectively (the four Charisma-based skills; the app has no 'Charisma-based' grouping, so it must be enumerated — do NOT use skill:'all', which would wrongly star Athletics/Stealth/etc.). needsEngineWork stays false. The initiative/class-DC-save half of the feat is correctly non-bonus and needs no entry.

problem: Incomplete — one typed bonus to the character's own stat is missing. The Crown suit reads: "If your harrow omen is Crowns, you gain a +2 status bonus to your Fortune-Telling Lore check." That is a +2 status bonus to a Lore SKILL check this character rolls, exactly the kind of thing the star exists for, and it is absent from the four listed bonuses.
correction: Add a fifth entry: bonus '+2 status', when: 'on the Fortune-Telling Lore check to hide your spellcasting after drawing a Crown, if Crowns is your harrow omen', targetKind 'skill', skill 'lore:fortune-telling' (build.ts:2207 slugifies a Lore subject by stripping the trailing " lore" and hyphenating, so that is the correct key shape). The other four entries (Key AC, Key saves, Book spell-attack Recall Knowledge, Star saves) are accurate as written; Hammer (force damage) and Shield (healing) correctly carry no typed bonus.

problem: Wrong target. The +1 circumstance bonus is to a kineticist IMPULSE attack roll, and the spec files it under targetKind 'spell' (the spell attack/DC statistic). A kineticist is not a spellcaster and has no spell attack statistic on the sheet, so the star would either never render or — worse, on a dual-class or archetype caster — mark a spell attack the feat never touches. AoN's Kineticist class entry (aon-2e-archive by-category/class/class-23.json) settles it: "Your impulse attack roll uses the same proficiency and attribute modifier as your kineticist class DC... Like a spell attack modifier, your impulse attack modifier uses the following formula" — it is only *like* a spell attack, it IS the class-DC statistic (Con + class DC proficiency, the same track derive.ts uses for Elemental Blast).
correction: Keep situational: true and the condition text ('on the Magnetic Pinions impulse attack roll against a target wearing metal armor or made of metal'). Change targetKind from 'spell' to 'classDc' — the closest legal kind and the statistic the roll is actually built from — and set needsEngineWork: true with the note that an impulse ATTACK ROLL is not the class DC itself (it is that statistic minus 10) and there is no impulse-attack target kind; the same gap affects every kineticist impulse-attack feat. The needsHumanDecision question should be restated as 'should impulse attack rolls get their own target kind, or ride classDc?' rather than 'is spell the right bucket?', which is answered: no.

problem: The condition is invented and mis-attributed. The record says: "When you Treat a Disease or a Poison, or someone else uses one of these actions on you, increase the circumstance bonus granted on a success to +4". The spec's `when` reads "...or someone with this feat treats you" — the text imposes NO requirement that the treater have the feat (the feat is yours; any treater's success gives you +4). The other half is also wrong on your own sheet: when YOU Treat a Disease/Poison on an ally, the improved +2→+4 goes to the PATIENT, not to you, so "after you Treat a Disease/Poison" should not appear as a condition on your own save unless you treated yourself. Confirmed identical wording in the AoN mirror (feat-5207.json / feat-836.json).
correction: Keep situational: true, targetKind save / save 'all', bonus "+4 circumstance (instead of the usual +2)", but rewrite `when` to: "on your save against a disease or poison after anyone Treats that Disease or Poison for you — your feat raises the treatment's success bonus from +2 to +4". Add an engineNote: when you use Treat a Disease/Poison on an ALLY, the improved bonus lands on the ally and is not representable; the success→critical success upgrade is a degree-of-success change with no representation.

problem: The condition is broadened beyond the text. The record gives the +10-foot status bonus only in specific, gated cases: "Aquatic You gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed. If you already had a swim Speed, you instead gain a +10-foot status bonus to your swim Speed"; the same 'if you already had a climb Speed' gate for Forest/Mountain/Underground; and "Sky You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your fly Speed, if you have one." The spec's `when` ("swim Speed (aquatic), climb Speed (forest/mountain/underground), land Speed (plains), or fly Speed (sky)") reads as if the +10 always applies in those terrains — it does not. Only Plains grants the +10 unconditionally while in terrain. Verified against the AoN Player Core entry (feat-4866.json).
correction: Keep situational: true / targetKind speed, but rewrite `when` to: "while in your chosen favored terrain, if you have the unimpeded journey class feature — +10 ft to swim Speed (aquatic) or climb Speed (forest/mountain/underground) ONLY if you already had that Speed, +10 ft to land Speed (plains), +10 ft to fly Speed (sky) only if you have a fly Speed". The existing engineNote (gaining a swim/climb Speed you lacked is a grant, not a bonus) is correct and should stay; the needsHumanDecision about per-choice keying is also legitimate.

problem: Under-covers the record and silently drops half of it. The magus record says the +1 circumstance bonus applies "to your next attack roll against the creature" — in PF2e an attack roll includes a spell attack roll, which matters precisely because this is the magus feat (Spellstrike). The spec lists only strikeAttack and buries the omission in an engineNote ("unclear whether the 'spell' target kind means spell attack roll or spell DC") without setting needsHumanDecision, so a magus would never see the marker on the stat they most often attack with.
correction: Either add a fourth entry { bonus: '+1 circumstance', when: 'on your next spell attack roll against a creature you critically identified with Recall Knowledge (ends after 1 minute if unused)', targetKind: 'spell' }, or set needsHumanDecision: true with the question "Does target.kind 'spell' mean the spell attack roll or the spell DC? If it is the attack roll, feats that buff 'your next attack roll' need a spell entry alongside strikeAttack." The rest of the entry (AC, save 'all', the magus-vs-knowledge-is-power-wizard note) is confirmed correct — both records exist.

problem: MISSED BONUS — spec says situational:false with reasonIfNot "It grants no bonus or penalty to any stat, so there is nothing to star." That is false: the engineer only read the first paragraph. The record's Mythic-Point paragraph reads "For the next month, you and your hierophant gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks against creatures in the area." (the area being the 10-mile radius that witnessed the detonation). The character is explicitly included ("you and your hierophant").
correction: situational: true, confidence high. One bonus: { bonus: '+2 status', when: 'for 1 month after you spend a Mythic Point on Pass Vengeful Judgement, on Intimidation checks against creatures that were within the 10-mile radius at that moment (your hierophant gets it too)', targetKind: 'skill', skill: 'intimidation' }. The rest of the feat (20d10 spirit damage, basic Fortitude, domain damage-type swap, Font of Life or Death vitality/void option) really is not a bonus — the reasonIfNot is only correct about the base action.

problem: UNNECESSARY needsHumanDecision — the question "Can the character be one of their own Bloc Tactics targets... or is the feat allies-only?" is answered by the record's own opening sentence, which the quoted evidence omits: "You have experience in undertaking direct action and know how to protect the identity and health of you and your allies when doing so." Nothing in the text restricts the half-your-level targets to other creatures, and the framing names you first.
correction: Drop needsHumanDecision (or downgrade to a note); raise confidence to high. Both bonuses stand as written on the character: +4 status to Deception vs seeing through the disguise (plus adding your level even if untrained) and +3 status to saves vs smoke, fumes and inhaled substances, both conditional on wearing the disguise you prepared during daily preparations. Worth adding a note that the OTHER selected targets are allies and would still need the ally channel if one ever ships — but that does not make this record needsEngineWork, because the owning character does benefit.

problem: WRONG TARGET on the second entry. The text is "you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC to avoid being Disarmed and Tripped" — that is the DC an opponent's Athletics check is rolled against, not a Reflex save the character rolls. Filing it under targetKind 'save'/reflex puts a star on the Reflex save row where a player will read it as "+2 to my Reflex saves under these conditions", which is not what the feat does. The brief explicitly forbids inventing a kind and requires needsEngineWork when the app has no stat for the thing being buffed; the engineer noted the mismatch in engineNote but did not set the flag.
correction: Set needsEngineWork: true with engineNote 'no DC-side channel — a bonus to the character\'s Reflex DC (what Disarm/Trip is rolled against) cannot be expressed by any listed target kind'. Either drop the save/reflex entry until that channel exists, or keep it only if the display renders it as a DC line rather than a save-modifier star. The first entry (+1 circumstance, Athletics to Disarm/Swim/Trip, while in the stance and unarmored) is correct and verified.

problem: WRONG TARGET / sign inversion. The text is "the targets focus on you and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to hit you" — the circumstance bonus sits on the ENEMIES' attack rolls, not on this character's AC. The spec records it as an AC entry with the value '-1 circumstance (effective; enemies get +1 to hit you)' and no needsEngineWork. (I checked the cited precedent and it does exist — situationalBonuses.ts has "barbarian-dedication": [{ targets: [{ kind: 'ac' }], when: "while raging", bonus: "-1 (penalty)" }] — but that one is a real penalty to the character's own AC from Rage, so it is not the same object: here the modifier lives on the attacker's side and competes with the attacker's other circumstance bonuses, not with the character's.)
correction: Keep situational: true but add needsEngineWork: true — 'the modifier is a circumstance bonus on enemy attack rolls against you; no enemy-side / attack-against-you channel exists.' If it is nevertheless shown on AC as an approximation, the entry must render unambiguously as a detriment and must not label the character as holding a -1 circumstance modifier. Also tighten the condition: the effect only lands on enemies that FAIL the check ("On a success" of your check against their Will DCs), lasts 1 round, or 3 rounds on a critical success, and the frequency is once per hour.

problem: Third bonus is recorded with targetKind 'strikeAttack' but the text is explicitly a SKILL-check bonus: "you gain a +2 circumstance bonus from Deft Cooperation (instead of a +1 bonus) the first time you attempt an attack roll or attempt a skill check where the bonus would apply." As written the registry would put a strike-attack star on the sheet twice and never mark any skill. The spec's own question admits this but it was still submitted wrong.
correction: Re-target entry 3 to { targetKind: 'skill', skill: 'all' } (nothing prevents mixed target kinds inside one record's entry list — the existing registry already does this, e.g. 'ageless-patience' targets perception AND skill/all in a single entry). Keep the when text: 'the first skill check after you critically succeed at Aiding an ally's skill check (requires Deft Cooperation)'. Entries 1 (save/reflex, Reflex DC vs Disarm) and 2 (strikeAttack) are correct as written; Reflex DC = 10 + the Reflex save modifier, so starring Reflex is faithful and the needsEngineWork flag for it is over-cautious rather than wrong.

problem: A conditional bonus is recorded as situational:false. The text is "While in Rain of Embers Stance, you gain a +1 status bonus to AC" with "**Requirements** You are unarmored" — that is two live conditions, not an unconditional bonus. The reasonIfNot argues from a different fact (the stances record carries acBonus:{value:1,type:'status'}, which I confirmed), i.e. 'don't register it because it's already displayed', which is not what the situational flag means. It also contradicts the same engineer's own treatment of fast-movement, which is likewise toggle-gated ("While you are raging") and was marked situational:true.
correction: Set situational:true, one bonus: +1 status, targetKind 'ac', when 'while in Rain of Embers Stance (requires being unarmored)'. Move the double-display concern to engineNote or to a separate suppress/alreadyModelled flag — the situational boolean must describe the RULE, not the app's current display state. Keep the human question, but reword it as 'should already-modelled toggles be suppressed at render time', which is a display policy, not a classification. Also worth carrying forward: the stance record models the +1 AC but not the unarmored requirement, so a player who toggles the stance while armoured gets a wrong AC today.

problem: Invented condition. The when says '+1 circumstance ... against divination effects, WHILE YOU WEAR YOUR MAGIC WARRIOR MASK'. The record's text does not gate the bonus on wearing the mask: "You hide your identity behind a mask representing an animal of your choice... You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against divination effects, though sometimes refusing to remove your mask can cause issues in areas that don't respect or understand the magic warrior tradition." The mask clause is flavour plus a social drawback; the only stated gate on the bonus is the effect type. (The archetype's real gate is the taboo — you lose the archetype's abilities if another creature learns your true face or name — which is not a per-roll condition either.)
correction: when: 'against divination effects'. Everything else in the entry (+1 circumstance, save/'all') is correct.

problem: The bonus is filed as two self-stars on the owner's Diplomacy and Performance, but the text gives it to someone else: "You spend 1 minute making quick adjustments to SOMEONE'S clothing and appearance ... the TARGET gains a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy and Performance checks." This is the same shape as helpful-halfling, tupilaq-carver, clan-protector and mask-familiar, which the same spec set correctly marked situational:false. As submitted it would put a +1/+2/+3 item star on the Diplomacy and Performance of a character who, in the normal case, gave the bonus away.
correction: Set situational:false with reasonIfNot 'the item bonus is granted to a target creature, not to the feat's owner', keep needsEngineWork:true (no channel for putting a bonus on another PC's sheet) and keep the human question about whether self-targeting should be allowed. If the owner is later ruled a legal target, re-add the two entries but the when must say 'if you spent 1 minute preparing YOUR OWN appearance, while speaking to the chosen audience', and note the size keys off the OWNER's Crafting proficiency (that part of the note is right).

problem: needsEngineWork is missing and the target is the wrong surface. The bonus is to SPELL DAMAGE ("you gain a status bonus to that spell's damage equal to the spell's level"), but targetKind 'spell' is the spell attack/DC surface — there is no spell-damage stat in the allowed kind list (strikeDamage is Strikes only). As submitted, the star lands on spell attack rolls / spell DC, which the feat does not affect at all. That is exactly the 'wrong target' failure mode.
correction: Keep targetKind 'spell' only as the least-bad host, but set needsEngineWork:true with the note 'no spell-damage surface exists; the app has strikeDamage for Strikes and spell for attack/DC, neither of which is spell damage'. The when text must lead with 'to the spell's DAMAGE' so a player reading the spell attack/DC star is not misled. The three-condition wording (from a slot, deals damage, no duration) is correct and the status type is correct.

problem: Incomplete — one bonus is missing. The spec captured only the Gather Information half. The text continues: "If you have the Sow Rumor feat, you can have your admirers assist you, with the same benefits as Gather Information." Sow Rumor is resolved with a secret Deception check (its own record: "the GM rolls a secret Deception check"), so the same +1 circumstance applies to a Deception check there, not Diplomacy.
correction: Add a second entry: bonus '+1 circumstance', targetKind 'skill', skill 'deception', when 'when your admirers assist you to Sow Rumor, while in a civilized settlement (requires the Sow Rumor feat)'. Confidence medium — the feat says 'the same benefits' rather than naming the skill. The existing Diplomacy entry is correct as written.

problem: The engineNote is inaccurate in a way that would produce a display bug: 'Swordmaster Dedication upgrades this to +2 on a critical Aid' is stated for the whole feat, but Swordmaster Dedication's text limits the upgrade to "the first time you attempt an attack roll or attempt a skill check where the bonus would apply" — the AC branch of Deft Cooperation is NOT upgraded. Applying the suggested '+1 (+2 on a critical Aid)' string to all three entries would over-state the AC bonus.
correction: Restrict the note to the strikeAttack and skill entries: 'Swordmaster Dedication raises the attack-roll and skill-check bonuses to +2 on a critical Aid; the AC branch stays +1.' The three bonus entries themselves (strikeAttack, ac, skill/all) are correctly targeted and correctly typed.

problem: WRONG TARGET on the 4th entry. The record's text is: "you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation skill checks. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to counteract checks." The spec parks the counteract bonus on targetKind 'spell' and calls it "an approximation". This feat grants NO bonus to spell attack rolls and NO bonus to spell DC, so whichever of those the 'spell' target resolves to, the sheet will display a +2/+3 the character does not have — the exact failure mode the brief calls out ("a +1 to Athletics to Climb recorded as a generic bonus"). The brief also says: when the app has no stat for a bonus, set needsEngineWork and say what is missing — not to attach it to the nearest wrong stat. (The three skill entries are exact and should stay.)
correction: Drop the 'spell' entry from bonuses. Keep only skill/deception, skill/diplomacy, skill/intimidation, each "+2 circumstance (+3 at 18th level)" / when "for 1 minute after you activate Don thy Fervor". Keep needsEngineWork true with the note: "counteract checks have no stat in the app; the +2/+3 circumstance bonus to counteract checks cannot be represented and is deliberately not attached to any existing target." Note this is the opposite call from cardinal-guardians, where the text really does say "spell attack modifier" — that one legitimately belongs on a spell-attack target once attack-vs-DC is separated.

problem: CONDITION BROADENED (minor). The record says the critical success grants "your ally the choice of a +2 circumstance bonus to one downtime activity skill check within the next week, OR the ability to roll twice on their next saving throw ... against an affliction". The spec's two entries read as if a critical success grants both: entry 1 says "+2 on a critical success" and entry 2 says "critical success only" with no indication they are mutually exclusive.
correction: Add the exclusivity to entry 2's condition, e.g. when: "critical success only, and only if the ally chooses this instead of the +2 downtime bonus — their next saving throw against an affliction within the next week". Everything else in this spec is accurate: all effects land on the ally ("You spend a day studying an ally"), so needsEngineWork true and no star on the feat holder's own stats is the right call.

problem: Self-contradictory record: situational is true but bonuses is an empty array and there is no reasonIfNot. The record's own text confirms the only typed bonus goes to the ENEMY ("The target of your Strike gains a +4 circumstance bonus to their Perception DC for this check"); the character gets nothing conditional. A consumer that branches on situational===true will look for entries and find none, and the chunk's own convention for 'no player-facing bonus' (lavasoul, spell-swipe) is situational:false + reasonIfNot.
correction: Set situational:false with reasonIfNot: "No bonus to any of the character's stats. The feat's only typed bonus (+4 circumstance) is granted to the Strike's target, raising their Perception DC and making the character's own Stealth check HARDER. It must never be recorded as a bonus for the character." Keep needsEngineWork:true only if the project wants to track enemy-side modifiers; otherwise drop it.

problem: The AC condition is broadened past what the text supports, and it is marked confidence:high / needsHumanDecision:false. The record reads "gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you" — the trailing clause "against spells that target you" can grammatically attach to BOTH the AC and the saves, and its own successor feat (Preternatural Parry, which lists Spell Parry as a prerequisite) restricts both halves to the triggering effect. The spec asserts the AC half "applies to everything while the guard is up", which is one reading, not the text.
correction: Keep both entries but set needsHumanDecision:true with the question: "Does Spell Parry's +1 circumstance AC apply against all attacks, or only against spells that target you? The clause placement is ambiguous and the app owner should pick the ruling." Until then phrase the AC `when` as "until the start of your next turn after using Spell Parry, as long as you keep a hand free (GM call whether the AC half is limited to spells that target you)". Downgrade confidence to medium.

problem: The evidence is not the record's text. The spec quotes "its target takes 1d6 [persistent bleed]", but core.json actually reads "its target takes 1d6." — the damage type is missing entirely from the stored description. The engineer silently repaired the record while quoting it, which breaks the 'ground it in the record's own text' rule and hides a genuine data defect.
correction: Verdict (situational:false, no tracked-stat bonus) is correct and stands. Replace the evidence with the literal string "its target takes 1d6. Your eidolon gains an item bonus to this bleed damage equal to the unarmed attack's item bonus to attack rolls. This is a critical specialization effect." and add to the engineNote: core.json's Bloodletting Claws description is truncated — the printed feat is 1d6 persistent bleed damage, so this record needs a data fix in the importer/description lane (separate from, and in addition to, the missing critSpec flag the spec already noted).

problem: The condition is broader than the rules allow. The bonus rides on Arcane Cascade, and the Arcane Cascade action in core.json says "While you're in the stance, your melee Strikes deal 1 extra force damage" — melee only. The spec's `when` never says melee, so a starlit span magus (whose ranged Spellstrikes get no Arcane Cascade damage at all) would see a strike-damage star that never applies to the attacks they actually make. The spec also implies Arcane Cascade's own damage is a bonus; it is a flat extra-damage rider of 1/2/3 (force, or the triggering spell's type).
correction: Rewrite the `when` as: "on MELEE Strikes only, until the end of your next turn, after you resist a foe's harmful spell while already in Arcane Cascade — the +2 status raises the Arcane Cascade extra damage (1/2/3 by weapon specialization), not the whole damage roll." Keep targetKind strikeDamage, needsEngineWork:true.

problem: The needsHumanDecision question states the bonus is "+1 or +2, higher with a tower shield". That is wrong: core.json gives tower-shield acBonus 2, identical to steel-shield (buckler is 1). The tower shield's +4 is only reached via the separate Take Cover action ("AC increases to +4 if you are using the Take Cover action"), which this reaction does not grant, so a tower shield never yields more than +2 here.
correction: Fix the question text to: "The bonus size is not printed on the feat — it is whatever the raised shield or the shield spell grants (+1 for a buckler or the shield spell, +2 for most shields including a tower shield). Should the display string stay generic or resolve from the equipped shield?" The two entries (ac + save:'all') and the classification are otherwise correct.

problem: The needsHumanDecision question offers "attach it to the splendid psychopomp mask item record once the item lane is wired up" as if that were a safe deferral. It is not, and the spec did not check: the item exists in core.json as items/splendid-pyschopomp-mask (id misspelled 'pyschopomp'), and its description is an EMPTY string — it carries no mention of the +1 item bonus to Intimidation. The feat also has no descRef pointing to it (unlike skull-creeper, which does descRef items/splendid-skull-mask, and that item's text does state the bonus).
correction: Keep situational:true and the single +1 item / intimidation entry, but restate the question: "The +1 item bonus comes from a worn (mask) item. Register on the feat, or on the item? Note that items/splendid-pyschopomp-mask has an empty description and a misspelled id, and the feat carries no descRef to it — so deferring to the item lane would drop this bonus entirely until that item record is repaired. Skull Creeper's equivalent item (items/splendid-skull-mask) IS populated, so the two feats cannot be deferred symmetrically today."

problem: The +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves is ALREADY folded into the computed total by the engine, so a feat-keyed situational entry double-reports it. core.json stances['cobra-stance'] carries saves.fortitude {value:1,type:'circumstance'}, and derive.ts:172-173 reads it ("The active stance/form may grant a save bonus (Cobra Stance: +1 Fortitude), typed so it pools") whenever the stance is active. The spec's own engineNote spots the stance data but then concludes the star "covers it in practice" — it does not: the player would see +1 already inside the Fortitude number AND a star claiming +1, and because the registry is keyed on the FEAT id the star would light merely because the feat is owned, even out of stance.
correction: Do not author the Fortitude-save leg here at all — it is already in the maths via the stance lane. The only genuine uncovered part is the Fortitude DC ("+1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and your Fortitude DC"), for which no target kind exists; record that as needsEngineWork with the save-DC gap and leave the save itself to the stance lane. The poison resistance (half your level) is likewise already carried by the stance record's resistances field.

problem: Mis-shaped as a registry entry. The text is "the circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and Fortitude DC granted by Cobra Stance increases from +1 to +2" — an in-place upgrade of a number the engine already computes from stances['cobra-stance'].saves.fortitude. Authoring it as a save/fortitude situational bonus alongside the cobra-stance entry gives a character who owns both a computed Fortitude that still says +1 plus two contradictory stars (+1 and +2).
correction: This is a DATA/engine fix, not a situational entry: stances['cobra-stance'].saves.fortitude must become 2 when the character owns cobra-envenom (nothing in src/ currently references 'cobra-envenom', so the upgrade is entirely unimplemented and a Cobra Envenom monk gets +1 today). Set situational false with needsEngineWork true describing that upgrade, plus the same Fortitude-DC gap noted on cobra-stance.

problem: The condition is narrower than the text. core.json reads "Your first attack that hits a frightened creature after you roar and before the end of your next turn gains a +4 circumstance bonus to damage" — ANY frightened creature. The spec's `when` says "against a creature frightened by your Dragon Roar", which would tell a player at the table they lose the bonus against a creature frightened by an ally's Demoralize, when in fact they get it.
correction: Rephrase to: "on your first attack that hits a frightened creature after you Dragon Roar, before the end of your next turn (requires Dragon Stance; the effect ends immediately if you leave Dragon Stance)". Bonus (+4 circumstance) and target (strikeDamage) are correct.

problem: The classification (unconditional, belongs in the maths) is right, but needsEngineWork:false is wrong. NO feat record in core.json carries a `saves` field — I counted 0 across the whole feats collection — so there is no data lane by which an unconditional feat-granted save bonus can reach the computed total. Marking it situational:false with no engine flag means the +2 status bonus to Fortitude and Will vanishes from the sheet entirely: not in the number, not on a star.
correction: Keep situational:false, but set needsEngineWork:true: "core.json has no feat-level `saves` field (0 feats carry one) and derive.ts has no feat→save lane, so this unconditional +2 status to Fortitude and Will is currently invisible. A `saves` grant field on feats (parallel to the existing `speeds` field, 72 feats) is needed before 'it belongs in the maths' is true."

problem: The classification (ally's AC, nothing to star) is correct, but the engineNote misstates the data. It claims 'guardians-deflection' has "no level field" — the record has "level": 4. It also says there are exactly two near-duplicate records; there are three records named Guardian's Deflection, and the third, `guardians-deflection-fighter` (level 6, edition remaster), is a DIFFERENT feat (the Fighter version), so "applied to both" is ambiguous and risks sweeping it in.
correction: Correct the note to: 'guardians-deflection' (level 4, edition remaster, raw AoN-style text block) is the live record; `guardians-deflection-swashbuckler` (level 4) is edition "superseded", so the app's existing edition algorithm already hides it and no manual suppression is needed; `guardians-deflection-fighter` (level 6) is a separate Fighter feat and must be classified on its own.

problem: The classification (ally's Will save, nothing to star) is correct, but the engineNote misstates the data the same way: it claims two near-duplicates, "one raw AoN-style text block with no level field". The record 'snap-out-of-it' does have "level": 4. There are three records with that name, and the third is not a duplicate.
correction: Correct the note to: 'snap-out-of-it' (level 4, category archetype, edition remaster) is the live record; `snap-out-of-it-marshal` (level 4) is edition "superseded" and already hidden by the edition algorithm; `snap-out-of-it-pathfinder-agent` (level 8, category skill, edition neutral) is a distinct feat needing its own classification.

problem: Wrong bonus magnitude in the parenthetical. The spec writes the bonus as "+your raised shield's circumstance bonus (usually +1; +2 for a tower shield)", which inverts the actual shield values. core.json: items/buckler acBonus 1, items/steel-shield acBonus 2, items/tower-shield acBonus 2. The +1 case is the buckler (the uncommon case); +2 is the normal shield, tower shields included. The feat itself says only "you gain your shield's circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would deal void damage" — it names no numbers, so the parenthetical is the reviewer's gloss and it will be read at the table as "+1" by most shield users who actually get +2.
correction: Keep situational true, targetKind save / save 'all', when "while your shield is raised, on saves against effects that would deal void damage". Change the bonus string to "+your raised shield's circumstance bonus (+2 for most shields, +1 for a buckler)". Optionally note that a tower shield's bonus rises to +4 only while you are also using Take Cover, which is an AC-specific clause the feat does not address (flag as needsHumanDecision if you want that resolved).

problem: Wrong target on the second bonus. The feat grants "a status bonus to damage" for spells cast from slots — it is a SPELL DAMAGE bonus. The spec maps it to targetKind 'spell', which in this registry is the spellcasting attack roll / spell DC stat, and then admits in engineNote that this is 'a best-effort mapping'. Starring the spellcasting attack/DC with '+status equal to the spell's rank' actively invites the player to add it to a spell attack roll or their spell DC, neither of which the text grants. Same class of error the brief warns about (a damage bonus recorded on an attack/DC stat).
correction: Drop the targetKind 'spell' entry entirely. Keep the strikeDamage entry ("+status equal to your number of weapon damage dice", for 3 rounds, vs undead / creatures holding an imprisoned soul / creatures you have witnessed create or command undead — note core.json says 'witnessed', not 'seen'). Keep needsEngineWork true, with the note now reading: spell DAMAGE has no target kind in the list (the 'spell' kind is the spellcasting attack/DC), so this half cannot be marked until a spell-damage marker or a Spells-tab display exists; also the whole package can be redirected to a willing creature in the spiral's light, which the registry cannot express.

problem: The bonus ladder is incomplete and starts too high. The feat's first effect is "Add Lastwall soup to your list of herbal items" — at 4th level the holder makes BASE Lastwall soup, which items/lastwall-soup gives as "a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs against undead". The spec's single entry begins at +3 and its 'when' says "after you eat improved or greater Lastwall soup", so levels 4-9 (the majority of the feat's life) are unrepresented. Secondary: the bonus is to "Stealth checks and DCs against undead" and only the check half is captured — the DC half is the same DC gap flagged on other records, but it is not mentioned here.
correction: Both human-decision questions are CONFIRMED and should stay: (a) the feat by itself grants nothing until soup is eaten, and (b) the +3/+4 conflict is real — feats/gravelands-herbalist says Greater grants "+4 item bonus" while items/lastwall-soup-greater's own text says "+3 item bonus" (and still calls itself 'improved Lastwall soup', so that record looks like a copy-paste of the Improved entry). Fix the emitted bonus to the full ladder: "+2 item (base soup), +3 at 10th (Improved), +4 at 18th (Greater, per the feat; the item record says +3)", when: "for 1 hour after you eat Lastwall soup, to Stealth checks and DCs against undead". Add to the engine note that the 'and DCs' half has no target kind.

problem: Inconsistent DC handling, and needsHumanDecision is wrongly false. The +4 circumstance bonus is to your Deception DC (what observers roll Perception against), not to any Deception check — the spec says so itself and still emits a skill/deception marker. In the same batch the reviewer deliberately emitted NOTHING for the identical DC-only situations: stalwart-standard (allies' Fortitude/Reflex DCs) and that's-not-natural (your Perception DC vs those creatures' Stealth). So the same problem is resolved two different ways, and the Deception star can be misread as +4 on Impersonate checks.
correction: Either emit nothing (consistent with stalwart-standard and that's-not-natural) or emit for all three — but do not decide it silently. Set needsHumanDecision true with the question: "Should a bonus that applies only to a DERIVED DC (Deception DC vs Impersonate, Perception DC vs Stealth, Fort/Reflex DC vs Disarm/Grapple/Shove/Trip) get a star on the underlying check, or be suppressed until a DC concept exists?" If it is kept, the current 'when' wording is already explicit enough; the condition itself checks out — the disguise lasts until you are no longer satiated and works once per individual creature.

problem: Not an error in the spec, but it will be dropped as a duplicate if applied blindly: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts ALREADY contains a numb entry, and that existing entry is wrong — it reads bonus "+1 circumstance (+2 while your body is destroyed)". 'destroyed' is not a state in this archetype; feats/zombie-dedication says "While your body is deteriorated, you're Slowed 1", so the spec's 'Deteriorated' is the correct reading of the word core.json's numb text drops ("While your body is , your numbness amplifies").
correction: Apply the spec as a REPLACEMENT of the existing "numb" key, not a skip. Final entry: targets [{kind:'save', detail:'all'}], when "against emotion and pain effects (while Deteriorated, a success on such a save becomes a critical success)", bonus "+1 circumstance (+2 while Deteriorated)". Also worth a pass over the rest of the registry for other entries authored from the same truncated core.json sentences.

problem: Structurally broken: situational is true but the spec carries NO bonuses array at all (only needsEngineWork + engineNote). A record flagged situational with zero entries either fails the loader or stars a stat with nothing to display. The engineNote's own reasoning ('no allowed target kind fits, using strikeDamage would put the marker on the wrong statistic') is the argument for NOT marking this character at all.
correction: Flip to situational:false with reasonIfNot: 'The bonus applies to the damage of the Destructive Vengeance champion reaction, which is neither a Strike nor a spell — no allowed target kind can hold it, and strikeDamage would mark the wrong statistic. Nothing on this character's own sheet changes.' Keep needsEngineWork:true and the engineNote (variable size = the reaction's damage dice count; applies only to the enemy's share, not the self-damage). Text verified: 'You gain a circumstance bonus to the damage you deal from Destructive Vengeance equal to the number of damage dice from the reaction.'

problem: Condition broadened. The spec's when reads '...to determine whether it is disguised or transformed'. The record grants the +2 only for the disguise case: 'When you actively Seek a creature within range of your scent, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception check to determine if it's disguised.' The transformation detection is a SEPARATE, earlier clause — a GM-rolled secret check that happens passively 'even if you didn't spend an action to Seek' and carries no bonus. As written the spec tells the player the +2 applies to a check it does not apply to.
correction: when: 'on your Perception check to determine if a creature is disguised, when you actively Seek it within range of your scent'. Everything else (targetKind perception, +2 circumstance, situational true) is correct. The scent sense grant and the passive secret check for transformed creatures are separate mechanics, not bonuses.

problem: Condition dropped. The spec's when is 'after Tumbling Through that opponent's space', which omits the two gates the record actually imposes: 'If you succeed or critically succeed and don't end your movement adjacent to that opponent, you can attempt to Create a Diversion.' A failed Tumble Through, or one that ends adjacent, grants nothing — the spec as phrased reads as though any Tumble Through unlocks it.
correction: when: 'on the Deception check to Create a Diversion, after you succeed at Tumbling Through that opponent's space and end your movement not adjacent to it'. Bonus string '+1 circumstance (+2 if you critically succeeded at the Tumble Through)', targetKind skill/deception and situational:true are all correct against the text.

problem: needsEngineWork:false contradicts its own engineNote ('when the ally is the target the bonus belongs on their sheet, which the app cannot show') and is inconsistent with how the same self-or-ally structure was flagged elsewhere in this batch — known-weaknesses, connect-the-dots, clue-them-all-in and lead-investigator all set needsEngineWork:true for exactly the missing 'bonus conferred on another character' lane. A downstream pass filtering on needsEngineWork will not see this gap.
correction: Set needsEngineWork:true, engineNote: 'Missing target — a bonus conferred on an ally's AC. Only the self case (you are the target of the triggering ranged attack) is representable.' The bonus itself is verified correct: '+2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack', targetKind ac, situational true.

problem: Same defect as snap-falling-fruit: needsEngineWork:false while the engineNote states the ally case is 'not representable'. Inconsistent with the true flag used for every other ally-conferred bonus in this batch.
correction: Set needsEngineWork:true, engineNote: 'Missing target — a bonus conferred on an ally's AC (trigger reaches an ally within 10 feet). Only the self case is representable.' The bonus is verified correct against 'You or the triggering ally gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.'

problem: The mechanics in the spec are right (+2 circumstance on the Investigate / Recall Knowledge check when you lick or taste, skill 'all'), but the spec treats this as a NEW entry and never notices that src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts ALREADY has a supertaster key — and the existing one is a misread: `"supertaster": [{ targets: [{ kind: 'perception' }], when: "Perception to detect alterations/additives in food or drink you consume", bonus: "+2 circumstance" }]`. The record grants no bonus at all to that check: "The GM rolls a secret Perception check against a DC determined by the poison's level" — the only +2 in the text is the taste-while-Investigating one. So a currently-shipping star on Perception is fabricated, and appending the spec verbatim also produces a duplicate property in the object literal (TS1117, build error).
correction: REPLACE the existing supertaster entry rather than adding one. Final entry: targets [{ kind: 'skill', detail: 'all' }], when "when you lick or taste something while Investigating or Recalling Knowledge to identify it, and the taste is relevant (GM's call)", bonus "+2 circumstance". Delete the perception target — no bonus applies to the automatic poison-detection Perception check.

problem: Spec is presented as a new authoring, but shadowplay is already in the registry with the same content: `"shadowplay": [{ targets: [{ kind: 'skill', detail: 'acrobatics' }], when: "Tumble Through the opponent's space after a damaging melee Strike", bonus: "+2 circumstance" }]`. Adding the spec as a second key is a duplicate object-literal property (TS1117) — a build break, not a data improvement. (Bonus, target and condition themselves are correct against the record.)
correction: Mark this one as already-covered / no-op, or merge into the existing key. If you want the spec's slightly fuller phrasing, edit the existing entry's `when` in place to "on the Acrobatics check to Tumble Through with Shadowplay (requires your last action was a melee Strike that damaged that opponent)" — do not add a second key.

problem: The engineNote states as fact that "the record has no top-level `level`/`category` before the description". The record does carry both: "level": 13 and "category": "ancestry" (they simply sit after `description` in key order). Left as written it invites a data 'fix' for fields that are not missing.
correction: Drop the level/category claim. The only real data-hygiene issue is the unprocessed AoN blob in `description` — it repeats the feat name and carries "Source Tian Xia Character Guide pg. 50" and "Prerequisites Shifting Faces" as body text (and the record has no `prerequisites`/`actionCost`/`source.license`, unlike its siblings). Mechanics of the spec (+1 circumstance to Intimidation while Changed Shape into a Large or Huge form) are correct.

problem: The lore skill key is wrong. The spec uses target skill `lore:bardic-lore`. The app's canonical lore key is `lore:<subject>` with the word "Lore" STRIPPED — `loreKey()` in src/builder/shared.tsx:3061-3068 does `.replace(/\blore\b/g, '')`, so "Bardic Lore" canonicalises to `lore:bardic`. Worse, `loreLabel()` (shared.tsx:3051-3057) appends " Lore" to the slug, so `lore:bardic-lore` would render as "Bardic Lore Lore" and would never match the character's actual proficiency key. The spec also files this under needsHumanDecision:false / needsEngineWork:true with the key marked "assumed" — the key is answerable from the code, no assumption needed.
correction: Use skill `lore:bardic`. Keep needsEngineWork:true, but only for the real gap: the entry must be gated on the character also having the `bardic-lore` feat (core.json feats['bardic-lore'] exists), and the registry has no second-feat predicate. Entry: { targets: [{ kind: 'skill', detail: 'lore:bardic' }], when: "on Bardic Lore checks (only if you have the Bardic Lore class feat)", bonus: "+1 circumstance" }.

problem: The condition is broadened — it drops the tradition restriction from the BONUS and states it only on the trigger. Spellmaster's Resilience (core.json, verified) gives "+1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells and effects with that tradition's trait"; Tenacity only says "increase the circumstance bonus to saving throws from the Spellmaster's Resilience feat to +2". The spec's `when` reads "for 1 minute after this reaction fires — once per day, when you critically fail a save against a foe's spell of your chosen tradition", which a player will read as +2 to ALL saves for 1 minute. Second problem: spellmasters-resilience is ALREADY in the registry (situationalBonuses.ts line 309, targets save/all, when "against spells and effects of your chosen tradition", bonus "+1 circumstance"), so adding this as a plain "+2 circumstance" entry puts two save stars on the sheet that read as stacking (+1 and +2) rather than one replacing the other.
correction: Re-word the `when` to carry the tradition restriction on the bonus itself and mark it as a replacement: { targets: [{ kind: 'save', detail: 'all' }], when: "against spells and effects of your chosen tradition, for 1 minute after this reaction (once per day, when you critically fail such a save)", bonus: "+2 circumstance (replaces Spellmaster's Resilience's +1; its resistance also rises to 10)" }. Flag needsEngineWork:true for the real gap — the registry cannot express "this entry supersedes entry X while active", so both stars will show at once.

problem: The Disable target is narrowed beyond what the record says. The text is "a +2 circumstance bonus ... to checks to Disable magical traps" — it names no skill. The spec assigns skill `thievery` with confidence "high" and needsHumanDecision:false. Magical traps routinely publish Disable entries for Arcana / Nature / Occultism / Religion (and the trap's own listed skill) as well as Thievery, so a Thievery-only star under-reports — and it is inconsistent with the same engineer's own sure-foot call, where an unnamed skill was deliberately given detail 'all' to avoid over-narrowing.
correction: Either use skill 'all' with when "on checks to Disable magical traps (whichever skill the trap's Disable entry allows — usually Thievery)", or keep 'thievery' but set needsHumanDecision:true asking the owner whether unnamed-skill checks should star every skill or the most common one. The other three entries in this spec (perception vs finding magical traps, ac vs magical-trap attacks, saves vs magical traps with the degree-of-success upgrade folded in) are all confirmed correct against the record.

problem: The engineNote's list of panache-granting skills is factually wrong. It says "Acrobatics / Athletics / Deception / Diplomacy / Intimidation". Verified against core.json classFeatures: battledancer = Performance, braggart = Intimidation, fencer = Deception, gymnast = Athletics, rascal = Thievery (Dirty Trick), wit = Diplomacy (Bon Mot). So Performance and Thievery are missing, and Acrobatics is not a style skill at all — Acrobatics comes from Tumble Through, which the `panache` class feature grants the bravado trait for EVERY swashbuckler, and which the spec already covers in its own separate entry. Anyone using that note to narrow the target later would silently drop two styles.
correction: Fix the note to: styles are Performance (battledancer), Intimidation (braggart), Deception (fencer), Athletics (gymnast), Thievery (rascal), Diplomacy (wit); Acrobatics is the universal Tumble Through clause, not a style. Also set needsEngineWork:true — the app DOES know the chosen style (classFeatures battledancer/braggart/fencer/gymnast/rascal/wit), so narrowing skill 'all' to the one style skill is a real, doable engine improvement rather than a hypothetical. The three bonuses' sizes, types and the qualifying-condition list (clumsy, drained, enfeebled, frightened, sickened, stupefied) are confirmed correct.

problem: The save is broadened to 'all'. The record says the bonus applies "on their ongoing saves against poisons already present in their body". Poison is an affliction, and PF2e affliction/poison ongoing saves are Fortitude saves; there is no poison that calls for an ongoing Reflex or Will save. Starring Reflex and Will with "against poisons" tells a player at the table to add +2 to rolls that will never happen. The spec's stated reason ("to avoid over-narrowing") is also the opposite of the call it made on glyph-expert, where an unnamed skill was narrowed to one.
correction: Use save 'fortitude': { targets: [{ kind: 'save', detail: 'fortitude' }], when: "for 1 minute, on ongoing saves against poisons already in the body when you cast cleanse cuisine on the creature (you or a touched ally)", bonus: "+2 status" }. Keep needsEngineWork:true for the correct reason the spec gave — the spell can be cast on a touched ally, so the bonus may land on someone else.

problem: Invented condition. The spec's 'when' reads "an enemy just succeeded at against you", but the record's trigger is unqualified: "**Trigger** An enemy makes a successful Disarm, Escape, Grapple, Shove, or Trip attempt." Nothing in the text requires the maneuver be aimed at the character — by RAW an enemy Grappling an ally triggers it too. The displayed condition would make a player wrongly decline the reaction.
correction: Keep bonus '+1 circumstance (+2 if the enemy critically succeeded)', target skill/athletics, but reword when: "to your Athletics check the next time you take the same action (Disarm, Escape, Grapple, Shove, or Trip) an enemy just succeeded at; lost if unused by the end of your next turn" — drop 'against you'.

problem: Wrong target for the only bonus emitted. Mind Mace reads "You gain a status bonus to mental damage with spells you cast equal to the spell's rank" — that is spell DAMAGE, but the spec files it under targetKind 'spell', which in the sheet is the spell attack/DC line. The spec's own engineNote concedes it "may render on the wrong number", yet still emits it, so the star would land on a stat the feat never touches. Secondarily, the engineNote's blanket claim that "there is no initiative stat in the list" overstates the gap: the existing registry already files initiative bonuses under perception (e.g. 'all-this-has-happened-before' — "on your initiative roll (once per day)"; 'ambush-awareness' — "on Perception checks rolled for initiative").
correction: Emit NO bonus entry for this record. Set situational false/needsEngineWork true with the note: spell-damage has no target kind (only strikeDamage exists), Psychic Fist is an attribute substitution, and the +2 circumstance to psychic-duel initiative can only be filed under 'perception' IF duel initiative is a Perception roll — core.json's rules/psychic-duels record is empty (id + name only), so that is unverifiable from the data. Keep the human-decision question about duel-only bonuses.

problem: Condition narrowed. The text has two clauses: "a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to reposition or shove you. This bonus ALSO applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to force you to move." The second clause names no save type, but the spec folds it into the Fortitude and Reflex entries only, so a Will save against a forced-movement effect would show no marker.
correction: Keep the two DC entries (fortitude DC and reflex DC vs Reposition/Shove while in Anchor Stance, requires you're in or under water) but strip the saving-throw wording from them, and add a third entry: bonus '+2 circumstance', target save/'all', when "to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to force you to move, while in Anchor Stance (you must be in or under water)". The engineNote about the truncated "attempt a ." sentence is accurate — core.json really is cut off there.

problem: Wrong target: narrowed to save/fortitude on a bonus the text never restricts to a save type. The record reads "granting a +1 item bonus to saves and DCs against attempts to grapple or swallow you" — "saves" is unqualified, so any save prompted by a grapple/swallow attempt (e.g. a Reflex save against an effect that grabs you) qualifies. Foundry's own rule element for this item confirms it: selector ["saving-throw","fortitude-dc","reflex-dc","will-dc"], i.e. ALL saves plus all three DCs, predicated on action:grapple / action:swallow-whole. The spec's engineNote also contradicts its own choice: it states the practically important half is the Fortitude DC (which the player never rolls), then anchors the marker on the Fortitude save row — so the one row that gets a star is the roll least likely to happen, and Reflex/Will get no marker at all.
correction: Keep situational:true, +1 item, but set targetKind save with save:'all' (the registry's existing convention, as used by affliction-resistance / adaptive-vision). when: "against attempts to Grapple or Swallow you (the same bonus also applies to your Fortitude, Reflex and Will DCs against those attempts)". Leave needsEngineWork:true for the DC half (no save-DC target kind exists) and the needsHumanDecision question as written.

problem: The condition is narrowed beyond the text. Both bonus entries say the +2 applies "if the creature fails its save against your DC", but the record grants it on the creature's SUCCESS as well: "**Success** ... If your AC is being targeted, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC. If you need to attempt a saving throw, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the save." Only a Critical Success denies the bonus ("The spell or ability affects you normally"); on a Critical Failure the effect fails outright so no bonus is needed. As written the spec tells a player they get nothing on the enemy's success, which is wrong half the time.
correction: Reword both 'when' strings to cover success and failure, e.g. "against the triggering single-target spell or ability, unless the creature critically succeeds at its save against your class or spell DC (spend a Mythic Point)". Keep the engineNote's separate point that the crit-downgrade rider only happens on the creature's failure — that part is correct.

problem: Wrong target set: the four enumerated skills (arcana/nature/occultism/religion) do not cover the printed scope. The record says "You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all primary checks to perform a ritual" — unrestricted. Checking core.json's `ritualPrimary` field across all 151 ritual records, 28 of them (18.5%) name NO tradition skill at all: e.g. clone -> "Crafting (legendary)", seed-of-mercy -> "Medicine (expert)", wild-allegiance -> "Diplomacy (expert)", power-of-the-beasts -> "Athletics (expert)", the-unseeing-blade-master -> "Perception (master)", halt-death -> "Warfare Lore (legendary)", bonding-meal -> "Cooking Lore, Crafting, Performance, or Survival (trained)", band-of-heroes -> "Diplomacy (mythic) or Society (mythic)". So roughly one ritual in five would show no marker. The engineNote's "a handful of rituals" understates this by an order of magnitude, and it is inconsistent with the same author's use of skill 'all' for Recall Knowledge (instructive-strike, willing-runes), which is a NARROWER set of skills than ritual primary checks.
correction: Replace the four entries with a single entry: { bonus: '+2 circumstance', when: 'on the primary check to perform a ritual', targetKind: 'skill', skill: 'all' }. (One ritual's primary check is even literally 'any' — unfettered-mark -> "Crafting (master) or any (legendary)".) Note that Perception is also a legal primary check for the-unseeing-blade-master, so a perception entry is defensible too if the app owner wants full coverage.

problem: The mapping is right but the needsHumanDecision flag is unwarranted and would block shipping four correct stars. The record reads "For the next 10 minutes, you gain a +2 status bonus to checks made using Acrobatics, Occultism, Stealth, or Survival" — this is the standard PF2e enumerating construction ('checks made using any of these'), not a choose-one. Nothing in the text offers a choice: there is no 'choose one', no 'one of the following', and the duration is a flat 10 minutes rather than per-check. Compare the genuine choose-one wording used elsewhere in the same data ('choose any skill you believe they are trained or better in' — borrowed-ability).
correction: Drop needsHumanDecision/question, raise confidence to high, keep the four skill entries (acrobatics, occultism, stealth, survival) exactly as specified.

problem: WRONG TARGET (wrong save). The spec splits the "saving throws to resist these actions" half as Fortitude = resist a Grapple, Reflex = resist a Disarm, Shove or Trip. Shove is resisted with the Fortitude DC, not Reflex — verified in core.json: actions.shove says "Attempt an Athletics check against your target's Fortitude DC", actions.grapple likewise Fortitude, while actions.trip and actions.disarm both say Reflex DC. A player following the spec would look for the star on the wrong defence half the time.
correction: Keep the +1 circumstance Athletics entry (when: 'to Disarm, Grapple, Shove or Trip, while your divine spark is in this ikon'), but re-split the resist half: save/fortitude — 'to resist a Grapple or a Shove, while your divine spark is in this ikon'; save/reflex — 'to resist a Disarm or a Trip, while your divine spark is in this ikon'. The spec's own needsHumanDecision (phrase it as a bonus to your Fortitude/Reflex DC rather than to the saves) still stands and is worth asking.

problem: INVENTED THIRD ENTRY / DUPLICATE STAR. The record grants exactly two bonuses: "You and your allies in the lantern's aura gain a +1 status bonus to visual Perception checks to notice anything that is also within the aura and a +1 status bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge against creatures within the aura". The spec lists a THIRD bonus, targetKind 'perception', when: 'granted to allies in the aura as well (same two conditions)'. There is no third bonus — that is the same aura benefit re-stated from the allies' side, and because it is filed under targetKind 'perception' it would render a second, condition-less-looking star on the CHARACTER's own Perception.
correction: Delete the third entry outright (not 'drop it if…'). Two entries only: +1 status / perception / 'visual Perception checks to notice something inside your lit lantern's 20-foot aura', and +1 status / skill:all / 'to Recall Knowledge about a creature inside your lit lantern's aura'. Mention the ally-sharing in the engineNote as prose only.

problem: FALSE needsEngineWork. The spec says the record's "you gain a +3 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll" (from "While holding your tome, you can always roll a skill check for initiative against creatures or haunts using Esoteric Lore") "has no target kind — the app has no initiative stat". That is not true of this registry: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts already carries initiative bonuses on the stat that is actually rolled — e.g. 'harmlessly-cute': skill/deception, when "when you roll Deception for initiative", and seven perception-based initiative entries (ambush-awareness, swaggering-initiative, proximity-alert…). Here the roll is an Esoteric Lore skill check, and lore keys are supported (SituationalTarget documents `lore:*`; build.ts trains classes.thaumaturge.trainedSkills.lore === 'esoteric' as `lore:esoteric`).
correction: Add a third entry instead of the engine flag: bonus '+3 circumstance', targetKind 'skill', skill 'lore:esoteric', when 'when you roll Esoteric Lore for initiative against creatures or haunts, while holding your tome'. Keep needsEngineWork only for the genuinely unrepresentable part (nothing left here, so it can be dropped).

problem: CONDITION MIS-STATED (trigger dropped, and wrongly framed as an optional pick). The record's cell reads "Impulse Junction Fragments of stone float around you, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn" — the spec renders the condition as "if you took the earth impulse junction: until the start of your next turn after you use it", which (a) omits the actual trigger and (b) implies the junction is always a chosen extra. core.json classFeatures['kinetic-gate'] Single Gate says: "you gain an impulse junction, a benefit that occurs when you use an impulse of the chosen element that takes 2 actions or more … You can gain only one impulse junction per round" — so a single-gate earth kineticist has it automatically, and it only fires on a 2+ action earth impulse, once per round. As written a player would read the star as a standing AC bonus.
correction: Reword the AC entry's `when` to the printed trigger: 'when you use an earth impulse that takes 2 or more actions (once per round) — lasts until the start of your next turn'. Note in engineNote that Single Gate grants the element's impulse junction automatically, while dual/multi-gate characters choose it, so the 'if you took it' caveat applies only to the chosen case. The Athletics skill-junction entry is correct as written (the +1/+2 at 10th/+3 at 17th ladder is verbatim from classFeatures['gate-junction']).

problem: The PASSIVE half is marked situational (a star on strikeAttack), which contradicts this same engineer's own — and correct — reasoning on armored-skirt. Record text: "While wearing this ring, you add your level to your attack rolls with all weapons with which you are untrained." That is gated on the WEAPON'S PROFICIENCY, which is character data the sheet already knows, exactly like armored-skirt's "which armor is equipped" (rejected there as "not a table-time condition"). It is also not a typed bonus at all — it substitutes level into the untrained proficiency math. Worse in practice: the shipped SituationalTarget has no per-weapon granularity ('attack' is global), so this star would render on EVERY strike, telling a fighter who is trained/expert in the weapon they're holding that they get a bonus they do not get.
correction: Split the record. Drop the passive entry from the situational list (situational=false for that half) and record it as an engine gap instead: needsEngineWork=true, "untrained weapon strikes should use your level as the proficiency term while this ring is worn/invested — needs a per-weapon proficiency-override hook in the strike engine, not a display flag." KEEP only the activated entry as situational: "+2 circumstance (+4 if you are expert in any weapon)" / when: "once per day, free action, triggered when you make an attack with a weapon you're untrained in" / targetKind strikeAttack — that one is genuinely a triggered, typed, once-per-day circumstance bonus. If the owner prefers to keep a single informational star, this must at minimum be needsHumanDecision, because the global 'attack' target makes it read as applying to trained weapons too.

problem: Incomplete: the activated effect is omitted entirely. Verified text: "**Activate** ⟨2⟩ command / **Frequency** once per day / **Effect** You wield your great stature to make a Request of a creature. If you roll a success on the check, you get a critical success instead." That is a conditional, once-per-day improvement to a Diplomacy check, and the shipped registry already records exactly this class of non-numeric effect ("emotionless": "success becomes crit success"; "goloma-courage"). The same engineer also chose to include acrobat's-staff's reroll, so omitting this is internally inconsistent — a Diplomacy star would be missing on a character whose cloak demonstrably affects a Diplomacy roll.
correction: Add a second entry: bonus: "success becomes a critical success", when: "once per day, when you activate the cloak (2 actions, command) to Request something of a creature", targetKind 'skill', skill 'diplomacy'. Keep the existing +1 item / Make an Impression entry unchanged (it is correct, and the reciprocal Gather-Information-about-you clause is rightly called out as unrepresentable).

problem: Same omission as the base cloak. Verified text carries the same activation with "**Frequency** twice per day" (record's counters: max 2 per day), and the +2 item bonus half is correct.
correction: Add: bonus: "success becomes a critical success", when: "twice per day, when you activate the cloak (2 actions, command) to Request something of a creature", targetKind 'skill', skill 'diplomacy'.

problem: Same omission, and the major grade's activation is strictly stronger than the other two, so dropping it loses the most. Verified text: "**Frequency** three times per day ... If you roll a success on the check, you get a critical success instead. If you roll a critical failure on your Diplomacy check when you activate the cloak, you get a failure instead." The +3 item / Make an Impression half is correct.
correction: Add: bonus: "success becomes a critical success; critical failure becomes a failure", when: "three times per day, when you activate the cloak (2 actions, command) to Request something of a creature", targetKind 'skill', skill 'diplomacy'.

problem: The second bonus's condition says "you spend the reaction after damaging an aberration with the sword (once per round)". The record's own text is "**Activate** ⟨4⟩ envision / **Frequency** once per round / **Trigger** You damage an aberration with the *Kortos Diamond* / **Effect** You deal an additional 2d8 damage". ⟨4⟩ is a FREE ACTION, not a reaction — confirmed by the app's own glyph table in src/sheet/RichText.tsx (GLYPH_TITLE: '4': 'Free action', '5': 'Reaction'), and by the fact that records which really are reactions (spangled-riders-suit, jawbreaker-shield) print ⟨5⟩ and carry activationCost.type === 'reaction'. Player-facing text that tells someone to spend their reaction when the ability costs a free action is a table-level error.
correction: Change the 'when' to: "free action (envision), triggered when you damage an aberration with the sword; once per round". The +2 item bonus to saves against mental effects while wielding is correct as written. Separately, note the internal inconsistency: this spec registers an activated damage rider as a strikeDamage bonus while the jawbreaker-shield spec explicitly excludes its reaction as "an action, not a stat bonus" — pick one policy for activated riders.

problem: The spec pins this record to "for 10 minutes after drinking" and its engineNote claims "This record is the combined parent entry; the separate 'greater' record carries the 8-hour duration" — implying only two records exist. core.json actually has THREE: olfactory-obfuscator (the combined parent, level 3, no price, text says "For the listed duration"), olfactory-obfuscator-lesser (level 3, 9 gp, "For 10 minutes after drinking"), and olfactory-obfuscator-greater (level 10, 225 gp, 8 hours). The 10-minute duration belongs to the -lesser record, which has its own id and was not classified.
correction: On the parent record, phrase the condition without a duration: "+4 item, for the elixir's listed duration after drinking (10 minutes lesser / 8 hours greater), against Seek attempts by creatures using only scent — no bonus if they use any other sense". Add a matching entry for olfactory-obfuscator-lesser (+4 item, 10 minutes). Also flag the policy question the same way bloodhound-mask/vaccine/addiction-suppressant parents raise it: should combined parent records be registered at all when per-grade records exist, or would that double-star the stat?

problem: The condition is broadened past what the text grants the owner. The record says "Creatures within the line gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws and Charisma-based skill checks", and the item is described as aiming "the spotlight outward from your body" (usage: mounted-on-a-tripod-or-bracket, not invested). Nothing in the text puts the activator inside the line, and a line area emanating from you does not include your own space — so the spec invents "while you are inside the spotlight's beam" for the sheet owner and stars FIVE of that owner's stats (all saves + Deception/Diplomacy/Intimidation/Performance) off an ally/area buff. This directly contradicts the same chunk's own (correct) handling of shield-of-the-unified-legion, which was marked situational:false precisely because the novel effect targets allies rather than the bearer.
correction: Either set situational:false with reasonIfNot "the +1 item bonus goes to creatures standing in the beam, not to the person aiming the spotlight — there is no target kind for another character's stats" (keeping needsEngineWork for party/ally buffs), or keep the entries but set needsHumanDecision with the question "should an area buff the owner is not normally inside star the owner's own stats?". Do not register five starred stats on the owner as currently written. The skill list itself (the four Cha-based skills) is right.

id: alcohol, bloodeye-coffee, flayleaf, blood-sap, elven-absinthe, scour, sun-orchid-poultice, vaccine, bloodhound-mask (+ -lesser/-moderate/-greater), addiction-suppressant (+ -lesser/-moderate/-greater/-major)
problem: Every one of these correctly describes in its engineNote that the bonus only exists while a drug stage / elixir duration is ACTIVE and must not be marked from mere possession — but none of them sets needsEngineWork:true. zerk and olfactory-obfuscator set the flag for the identical gap. Since the registry keys off records the character has, an engine-work triage that filters on needsEngineWork will ship all of these as possession-triggered stars: carrying a flask of alcohol would permanently star your saves, and carrying an unused bloodhound mask would star Survival. The bonus values, types and targets in this group are all verified correct against the records.
